title: What is Provisional Credit?
summary: This document explains Rho-Bank “provisional credit” for credit card disputes: a temporary credit that may restore the disputed amount to your account while the investigation runs. It typically posts within a few business days; investigations can take days to several weeks, then credits become permanent if resolved in your favor or reversed if not.
